Kolte-Patil Homes and Projects in Bengaluru

Founded over three decades ago, Kolte-Patil Developers Limited (BSE: 532924, NSE: KOLTEPATIL) is one of Western India's premier real estate development companies. Driven by the philosophy of "Creation, Not Construction," we build self-sustaining ecosystems and timeless architectural benchmarks.

With an unbroken track record of financial stability and transparent governance, Kolte-Patil has redefined luxury living through its flagship 24K luxury brand and expansive integrated townships.

For homebuyers exploring Kolte Patil homes in Bangalore, the Bengaluru portfolio spans Electronic City, Horamavu, and North Bengaluru. Discover projects such as I-Towers Exente, Mirabilis, Raaga, and Lakeside 24, and compare apartment configurations, prices, floor plans, and amenities.

Architectural Overview

I-Towers Exente by Kolte-Patil Developers is a ready-to-move high-rise residential project at the entrance to Electronic City Phase 1, Bengaluru. Buyers looking for Kolte Patil homes in Bangalore’s Electronic City can explore 2 and 3 BHK residences across five towers, comprising 438 homes. The towers rise to 22 or 23 floors, and more than 70% of the development area is open space, with residences designed to take in open city views.

The project’s lifestyle facilities include a rooftop swimming pool and clubhouse, gym, yoga deck, squash and badminton courts, themed gardens, children’s play area, and the Aristotle digital library and study zone. Infosys, D-Mart, Hosur Road, IIIT Bangalore, and Electronic City Metro Station are among the nearby destinations. Review I-Towers Exente apartment configurations, floor plans, amenities, and pricing when comparing Kolte Patil projects in Bangalore. RERA Registration No. PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/171026/000862
